name: βH-2C-B
aliases: beta-hydroxy-2c-b, bh-2c-b, bh-2cb, bohb, boh-2c-b, boh-2cb
summary: β-Hydroxy-2C-B is a novel analogue of 2C-B that is a slightly less potent to 2C-B, and reportedly a longer duration. 2C-B is suspected to be the active metabolite of βk-2C-B.

helpfulLinks.title: TripSit Factsheet
helpfulLinks.description: Rapid harm-reduction summary and combination data

pharmacology.text: BOH-2C-B acts as a serotonin 5-HT2A receptor agonist.
pharmacology.kind: Serotonin 5-HT2 receptor agonist; Serotonin 5-HT2A receptor agonist; Serotonergic psychedelic; Hallucinogen

uses.text: It is the β-hydroxy derivative of 2C-B. The drug has been encountered as a novel designer drug.
